conventions: The paper's hypercharge already uses Q = T3 + Y (doublets with Y = 1/2), so no change was needed.
The paper's ⟨H_i⟩ = v_i/√2 with v = 246 GeV matches ADROIT; ADROIT's v = 246.22 GeV is used.

Rotated to the Higgs basis: H = cβ H1 + sβ H2 and Φ = −sβ H1 + cβ H2. The portal iB a0 H1†H2 + h.c. becomes iB a0 H†Φ + h.c. exactly, because the H†H and Φ†Φ pieces cancel. Since V enters L as −V, the term coupling is −iB.

B is written as (m_A² − m_a²) sin2θ/(2v) (eq. 17), and m_A0², m_a0² come from inverting the CP-odd mass matrix (eqs. 15–16). Neutral Φ⁰ = (ρ+iη)/√2 with η = −A0; this sign is absorbed consistently in the Yukawa and portal terms.
Type II Yukawas in the Higgs basis: Y_d = √2 m_d/(v cβ) and Y_u = √2 m_u/(v sβ) give the Φ couplings +√2 m_d tanβ/v, +√2 m_e tanβ/v and −√2 m_u cotβ/v. The H Yukawas (the SM masses) are left to G1.
The paper's typo Q̄ Y_d H̃2 u_R is read as Q̄ Y_u H̃2 u_R.
assumptions: λ_a and the H2 quartics are omitted, as directed by the reference's left-out list.
θ is taken in the branch with cos2θ > 0.
There is no CP violation: B and y_χ are real, as the paper assumes.

All V_2HDM quartics involving the second doublet left out (alignment/decoupling limit per the reference): Φ's CP-even, CP-odd and charged states all sit at m_A0; H keeps the SM potential, supplied by G1.
No m12² H†Φ mixing term in the Higgs basis, so H carries the whole vev (alignment, α = β − π/2).
θ taken in the small-angle branch: cos2θ = +sqrt(1 − sin²2θ).
Gamma_a and the product y_chi sin2θ tanβ are listed for completeness only; widths are computed by ADROIT.
